title: Customer & supplier drawer — information architecture
brief: Improve how identity, contact metadata, KPIs, ledger tables, and account actions (collect/pay, credit refund, manual adjustment) are organized inside the responsive customer and supplier drawers.

artboards.title: Account-first: move Details into its own tab
artboards.tradeoff: Gives maximum vertical room to KPIs, open items, and the statement inside the 672px drawer; hides secondary metadata (Created, Updated, Deactivate) one click away in a Details tab.

artboards.title: Statement-first with Action Toolbar + inline form panel
artboards.tradeoff: Cleanly separates reading the statement from recording mutations and scales to more actions without crowding a tab bar; opening an action form temporarily pushes the ledger down.

artboards.title: Split desktop drawer: Profile rail + Account workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps identity, KPIs, contact info, and the full-height ledger/forms visible simultaneously with zero scrolling to reach actions; needs a wider drawer (~820px) on desktop and stacks on mobile.

artboards.title: Refined 01 (no tabs): Details header box, 2 KPIs + actions, unified Balance ledger
artboards.tradeoff: Removes all tabs and accordions: puts details in a bordered header box with Edit/Deactivate, focuses the middle on Balance & Available credit with inline action buttons, and combines sales/purchases (with nested credit notes/returns), payments, refunds, and adjustments into one unified Balance ledger.
